basics.name: Roger Li
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with a background in bioengineering research and product management. I build frontend features now, and the PM years mean I can run the roadmap and client conversations around them too.

work.name: Jumbo

work.name: VidMob

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Built proof-of-concepts so product teams knew what a feature would cost before committing to it. Overhauled the API docs and wrote a new public-facing version. Technical lead for partnerships scoping new integrations.

work.name: VidMob
